source: generic reference: a televised European night match in heavy rain under four steel floodlight banks
why: Rain streaks are only visible where they cross a floodlight shaft, back-lit toward the camera against a dark sky
match: rain reads as thin slanted streaks inside the flood cones and disappears against the dark sky outside them
one dominant flood bank behind the far stand casts long player shadows toward the camera
haze glows around each bank; the sky above the roofline stays dark storm navy (top row luma <= 45)
the pitch stays the brightest large area of the frame (pitch cells 55-95), never a flat grey wash
